vāsayisu: [Vasa+ṇaya+uṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 Nīti,dhātu.184.]  they are living. Vāsayiṃsu(kri) [vasa+ṇaya+uṃ. Dhātvattha. Vāsa+ṇaya+uṃ. Dhātvattha.] they are making to get good smell.
vāsesu: [Vasa+ṇe+uṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 to let them lived there.
vāsāpesu: [Vasa+ṇāpe+uṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 let them have stayed somewhere.
vāyamitu: [Vāyama+tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To strive (or) to make effort.
vāyamisu: [Vāyama+uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 Kaccaññaḥ.504.rū.470.] they have made effort.
vāyapasasaka: [Vāya+pasaṃsaka] (ti) CL=7 one who used to praise Vāyodhāta. (Vāyodhāta means element of air (or) volatility (or) mobility).
vāyasamasa: [Vāyasa+maṃsa] (na) CL=7 meat of crow. see - Vāyasa(2)(1).
vāyitu: [Vī+tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 Nīti,dhātu.254. Ṇvādi.61,66,136,681. Nīti,dhātu.170.]  taking the scent, to weave (loom).
vāyosavaṭṭa: [Vāyo+saṃvaṭṭa] (pu) CL=7 destroyed (the world) by wind (or) (the world) come to an end due to wind.
vāyāpesu: [Vī+ṇāpe+uṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 Ve+ṇāpe+uṃ.] let them to make weaving (loom).
